test_cases.test_case: Successful login with required fields filled redirects to Dashboard

User not authenticated

3. Enter <password> in the Password field
4. (Optional) Check the Remember Me checkbox
5. Observe that the Login button becomes enabled
6. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: redirects to Dashboard

test_cases.test_case: Navigate to Forgot Password flow via the Forgot Password? link

steps: 1. Click the "Forgot Password?" link below the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Forgot Password flow

test_cases.test_case: Inline validation messages shown when required fields are empty and Login is attempted
preconditions: Login page is open
steps: 1. Clear the Tenant selection so it is empty
2. Clear the Username field so it is empty
3. Clear the Password field so it is empty
4. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation messages are shown for Tenant, Username, and Password fields

test_cases.test_case: Tenant dropdown left empty (required dropdown)
preconditions: User is on the Login page (not authenticated)
steps: 1. Navigate to the Login page
2. Clear the Tenant dropdown so its value is empty (remove default 'default')
3. Enter <valid username> in the Username field
4. Enter <valid password> in the Password field
5. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Tenant field displays an inline validation error indicating it is required; Login button remains disabled / form does not submit; user stays on the Login page (no redirect to Dashboard).

test_cases.test_case: Username left blank (required text/unspecified field)
preconditions: User is on the Login page (not authenticated)
steps: 1. Navigate to the Login page
2. Select <valid tenant> in the Tenant dropdown
3. Leave the Username field blank
4. Enter <valid password> in the Password field
5. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Username field displays an inline validation error indicating it is required; Login button remains disabled / form does not submit; user stays on the Login page (no redirect to Dashboard).

test_cases.test_case: Password left blank (required password field)
preconditions: User is on the Login page (not authenticated)
steps: 1. Navigate to the Login page
2. Select <valid tenant> in the Tenant dropdown
3. Enter <valid username> in the Username field
4. Leave the Password field blank
5. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Password field displays an inline validation error indicating it is required; Login button remains disabled / form does not submit; user stays on the Login page (no redirect to Dashboard).

test_cases.test_case: All required fields left empty and submit attempted
preconditions: User is on the Login page (not authenticated)
steps: 1. Navigate to the Login page
2. Clear the Tenant dropdown so it is empty
3. Leave the Username field blank
4. Leave the Password field blank
5. Attempt to click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Tenant, Username and Password fields each display inline validation errors indicating they are required; Login button remains disabled / form does not submit; user stays on the Login page (no redirect to Dashboard).

test_cases.test_case: Attempt login with invalid credentials (authentication failure)
preconditions: User is on the Login page (not authenticated)
steps: 1. Navigate to the Login page
2. Select <valid tenant> in the Tenant dropdown
3. Enter <valid username> in the Username field
4. Enter <incorrect password> in the Password field
5. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: An authentication error message is shown near the form indicating credentials are invalid; the form does not redirect to the Dashboard; user remains on the Login page (no successful login).

test_cases.test_case: Tenant set to empty blocks Login despite other required fields filled
preconditions: User is on the Login page
steps: 1. Ensure the Username field is empty
2. Ensure the Password field is empty
3. Set the Tenant dropdown to an empty value (choose the blank/placeholder option if available)
4. Enter <non-empty value> in the Username field
5. Enter <non-empty value> in the Password field
6. Observe the Login button state
7. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Form submission is blocked: Login button remains disabled or clicking it shows inline validation on the Tenant field indicating it cannot be empty; no redirect occurs and no Dashboard is shown (is blocked / error shown).

test_cases.test_case: Username and Password containing special characters and emoji are accepted by the input and enable Login
preconditions: User is on the Login page
Tenant is set to a non-empty value
steps: 1. Enter a string containing special characters and emoji (e.g., punctuation, symbols, emoji) in the Username field
2. Enter a string containing special characters and emoji in the Password field
3. Observe the Login button state
4. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Input acceptance succeeds: Login button becomes enabled (no client-side inline validation error shown on Username or Password). Clicking Login proceeds to server validation (either redirects to Dashboard on valid credentials or shows 'invalid credentials' error on failure) — the client did not block submission due to special characters.

test_cases.test_case: Very long Username input (200+ characters) is accepted by the field and does not cause client-side truncation
preconditions: User is on the Login page
Tenant is set to a non-empty value
steps: 1. Enter a very long string (200+ characters) in the Username field
2. Enter <non-empty value> in the Password field
3. Observe the Username field rendering (scroll/truncation) and the Login button state
4. Click the Login button
test_cases.expected_result: Input acceptance succeeds: the Username field displays the full entered string (no client-side truncation or immediate error shown) and the Login button becomes enabled. Clicking Login proceeds to server validation (either redirect on valid credentials or shows 'invalid credentials' error) — client did not block due to length.

test_cases.test_case: Forgot Password? link navigation works even when required fields are empty
preconditions: User is on the Login page
steps: 1. Ensure Tenant, Username, and Password are all empty
2. Click the 'Forgot Password?' link
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation succeeds: browser navigates to the Forgot Password flow page regardless of empty required fields (user is taken to the Forgot Password flow).

test_cases.test_case: Very long search string (>200 chars) in Search_Activity

Home page is visible
Search_Activity input is present
steps: 1. Focus the Search_Activity input
2. Enter a very long string (>200 characters) into the Search_Activity input
3. Press Enter or click the search submit control
test_cases.expected_result: Search executes successfully; the search results area updates (shows matching activities or a 'no activities found' message) and no inline error is shown. The Search_Activity input displays the entered value if the UI allows it, or displays the truncated prefix up to the field's visible/max length if the UI enforces a length limit (observer-visible truncation).

test_cases.test_case: Search with special characters, punctuation, and emoji

Home page is visible
Search_Activity input is present

2. Enter a string containing a variety of special characters, punctuation, and emoji into the Search_Activity input
3. Press Enter or click the search submit control
test_cases.expected_result: Search executes successfully; the search results area updates (shows matching activities or a 'no activities found' message) and no inline error is shown. The Search_Activity input preserves the special characters/emoji in its displayed value after submission (or shows a clearly visible escaped/truncated version if the UI normalizes characters).

test_cases.test_case: Leading and trailing whitespace in Search_Activity

test_cases.expected_result: Search executes successfully; the search query is trimmed of leading and trailing whitespace before execution and the Search_Activity input displays the trimmed value after submission (i.e., saved/displayed input shows no leading/trailing spaces).

test_cases.test_case: Rapid multiple clicks on Dashboard button

Home page is visible
Dashboard button is visible

test_cases.expected_result: First click succeeds and redirects the user to the dashboard view; subsequent rapid clicks are ignored (no additional navigation errors or duplicate redirects are shown). The user ends on the dashboard page with no visible error message and no duplicate side effects from multiple clicks.

on Home page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to use 'Search Activity' from a non-Dashboard page (control absent)

If the field is unexpectedly present, submitting it does not filter dashboard activities and the user is not navigated to Dashboard. Visible indicator: 'Search Activity' field is absent on non-Dashboard pages.

test_cases.test_case: Search icon not accessible when user is signed out

test_cases.test_case: Selecting a search result is blocked if user session is not active
preconditions: User is signed in
steps: 1. Click the Top_Toolbar_Search_Icon
2. Enter <query returning at least one result> into the Global_Search_Input
3. Wait for the Search_Results_Dropdown to populate with at least one result row

5. Click the first result row in the Search_Results_Dropdown (Select Result)
test_cases.expected_result: The Select Result action is blocked because the user is not authenticated: the browser is redirected to the Login page and the entity detail page is NOT displayed; no navigation to the entity detail occurs

test_cases.test_case: No-results branch displays correct message when query matches nothing

steps: 1. Click the Top_Toolbar_Search_Icon

test_cases.test_case: Very long search input (>200 characters)
preconditions: User is logged in
Top_Toolbar_Search_Icon is visible
steps: 1. Click Top_Toolbar_Search_Icon
2. Focus Global_Search_Input
3. Type <very long string (200+ characters)> into Global_Search_Input, character-by-character
4. Wait for Search_Results_Dropdown to update (live search completes)
test_cases.expected_result: The UI accepts the full input without silent truncation OR displays a visible truncation/validation indicator. If the input is accepted, Search_Results_Dropdown updates and shows matching rows (or 'No results found' if none). If the UI truncates or rejects the input, an inline indicator or validation message is shown on Global_Search_Input explaining truncation/rejection.

test_cases.test_case: Search with emoji and special/unicode characters

2. Focus Global_Search_Input

4. Wait for Search_Results_Dropdown to update (live search completes)
test_cases.expected_result: Search processes the Unicode/special characters and Search_Results_Dropdown displays any entities whose stored name/identifier contains the same characters. If no stored entities contain those characters, the dropdown shows the exact message 'No results found'. No unhandled errors or browser dialogs should appear.

test_cases.test_case: Leading/trailing whitespace and case-insensitive matching when selecting a result
preconditions: User is logged in
There exists an entity whose name/identifier matches <search term> ignoring case and whitespace

4. Wait for Search_Results_Dropdown to update (live search completes)
5. Click the matching row in Search_Results_Dropdown (Select Result)
test_cases.expected_result: Leading and trailing whitespace are trimmed and search is case-insensitive: the matching entity row appears in Search_Results_Dropdown. Clicking the result succeeds and navigates to the corresponding entity detail page. The navigation is visible (browser URL changes and entity detail page header is displayed).

preconditions: User is logged in with permission to create charges

test_cases.test_case: After logging out, direct navigation to an authenticated page is blocked (redirects to login)

steps: 1. Log in as <role>
2. Click the Profile Icon
3. Click the 'Log Out' button in the Profile Menu
4. After logout completes, in the address bar navigate to <authenticated page URL> directly
test_cases.expected_result: Browser is redirected to the login page; the requested authenticated page is NOT displayed; authentication session has been terminated (user remains on login page), confirming the direct navigation after logout is blocked

test_cases.test_case: After logging out, using the browser Back button does not return to authenticated content
preconditions: user is logged in as <role>
steps: 1. Log in as <role>
2. Navigate to an authenticated page <some authenticated page>
3. Click the Profile Icon
4. Click the 'Log Out' button in the Profile Menu
5. Click the browser Back button once
test_cases.expected_result: Browser does not display the previously visited authenticated content; user is shown the login page (or redirected to login); authenticated content is not accessible via Back button after logout, confirming the session was terminated and access is blocked

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click on Log Out button
preconditions: User is logged in
User is on an authenticated page with the Profile Icon visible
steps: 1. Click the Profile Icon to reveal the dropdown menu
2. Click the "Log Out" button
3. Immediately click the "Log Out" button a second time (within a short interval)
4. Observe the UI
test_cases.expected_result: Single logout action succeeds: user is redirected to the login page (login page is displayed once), no error message is shown, the Profile Icon and other authenticated UI are not visible, and subsequent navigation to authenticated pages redirects to the login page.

test_cases.test_case: Click Log Out, then use browser Back button
preconditions: User is logged in
User is on an authenticated page that was reached via typical navigation (so Back would return to a previous authenticated page)
steps: 1. Click the Profile Icon to reveal the dropdown menu
2. Click the "Log Out" button
3. Wait until the application redirects to the login page and the login page is displayed
4. Click the browser Back button once
5. Observe the UI
test_cases.expected_result: Browser Back navigation is blocked from restoring authenticated content: after Back is pressed the browser shows the login page (or immediately redirects to login), protected content is not visible, and the logout succeeds (authentication token cleared and session terminated).

test_cases.test_case: Log out in one tab then interact in another tab with authenticated page still loaded
preconditions: User is logged in
Authenticated pages are open in two separate browser tabs (Tab A and Tab B), both initially showing authenticated content
steps: 1. In Tab A, click the Profile Icon to reveal the dropdown menu
2. In Tab A, click the "Log Out" button
3. In Tab B (without reloading), click a link or button that would normally navigate within the authenticated area
4. Observe the UI in Tab B
test_cases.expected_result: Attempted navigation in Tab B is blocked from showing protected content: Tab B is redirected to the login page (or shows the login page when navigation completes), protected content is not accessible, and the logout in Tab A succeeds (authentication token cleared and session terminated).

test_cases.test_case: Click Profile Settings in dropdown immediately after clicking Log Out (race between logout and navigation)
preconditions: User is logged in
User is on an authenticated page with the Profile Icon visible
steps: 1. Click the Profile Icon to reveal the dropdown menu
2. Click the "Log Out" button
3. Immediately (before redirect completes) click the "Profile Settings" item in the same dropdown
4. Observe which page is displayed
test_cases.expected_result: Profile Settings navigation is blocked by the logout: the application redirects to the login page (login page displayed) rather than showing Profile Settings, protected content is not displayed, and the logout succeeds (authentication token cleared and session terminated).
